about: The Workbench icons of the Keen drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py icons/icons.json --out icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/omnispeak.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/omnispeak.png is it rendered at 128 x 128.
